The new sanitary sewer main will consist of 345 lf on new piping  in the new roadway right-of-way, 291 lf within the SCDOT right-of-way (45 lf open cut crossing under Rifle Range Road, 246 lf parallel to Rifle Range Road), 9 lf on Oakhaven HOA property followed by 121 lf between lots 1401 and 1403, then 3 lf to connect to the existing manhole in the School House Road right-of-way. New residential sewer services will be provided off of the new 8-inch gravity main within the new road right-of-way for the residential development. Permitting will be through MPWW as the DRP along with SCDHEC.
